summary: Answer-bank shortcuts solve all 39 independent samples, all five batch questions, and all three delivery survivors. Eleven eligible stored generated questions share the defect. Source replay is also stale. Package and database unchanged; full report saved in result.json.

source_analysis.skill: Find area using a supplied affine transformation and a Type I integral.
reasoning_steps: Transform boundaries and determine intersections and integration bounds.
Integrate the vertical width and select the exact area.
invariants: Invertible affine transformation and finite bounded region.
Source-supported integration workload and five-choice radio response.
permitted_variations: Transformation coefficients, determinant, translations, and domain dimensions.
Upper/lower boundary assignments within supported families.
Distractor relationships, correct-choice rank, and position.

source_replay.details: Six current banks replay exactly; q-82874 has an obsolete extra field. Five additional supplied profiles are unsupported.

math.details: Independent integration verifies all 44 current sample/batch keys and distinct choices; source errors are documented separately.

variety.details: All eight implemented families vary numerically but preserve answer-revealing distractor relationships.

scope.details: Tested normal output preserves the source methods, representations, and response contract.

grading.details: Native grader: 55 valid selections accepted and 176 wrong selections rejected. All tested fields are radio.

rendering.details: Eleven actual-UI renders inspected across eight templates and controlled pairs; no reported math or image errors.

packaging.details: Relocation, deterministic replay, boundary rejection, finite-limit handling, and exact dependency versions verified. All 2,885 package files unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Counterfactual dependencies work, but signed-pair and median shortcuts bypass the intended reasoning and survive delivery and eligible easy-pool selection.

findings.description: Selecting the unique positive choice with a negative counterpart reveals the correct area. Selecting the median also succeeds throughout the tested output. All three batch survivors remain vulnerable.
source_refs: generate/principles.md: surface variation with a fixed decision structure
